texts.DreamAftermath: That dream again...\p“Don't send me away...”\pWhy would I say that?\pI can barely remember any of it.
texts.CheckPC:
That's my PC.
I should check it.
texts.Delivery: DELIVERY NOTICE\pYour order has been processed.\pDelivery is scheduled to arrive shortly.\pThank you for your purchase.
texts.OrderReaction: My order?\pI didn't order anything.\pThat's weird...\pAnd the clock still isn't set.\pI should probably fix that before I go downstairs.
texts.PCFirst: I should check the PC first.
texts.ClockFirst: Clock first.\pElara will definitely say something if I leave it like that.
texts.ClockDone:
There.
Much better.\pNow the clock's set.
texts.Talk3:
Yeah.
Just had a weird dream.
texts.Talk5:
I think so.
I can't really remember it.
texts.Talk7:
Actually...
A package just arrived for you.
texts.Talk9:
That's what it says.
Your name and everything.
texts.Talk13: My PC said an order was arriving too.
texts.Talk17: Let's at least see what's inside.
texts.After1: That's definitely not something I'd expect to arrive in the mail.
texts.After3:
I've heard of them.
They're used by Trainers in other regions.
texts.After4:
But why someone sent one to you...
I have no idea.
texts.After5: Keep it with you for now.
texts.After6: Just don't start pressing buttons until we know where it came from.
texts.After8:
I'm your mother.
Being oddly specific is part of the job.
texts.After9:
Come downstairs when you're ready.
There's something else I need to tell you.
